agent-card-container-fields.imageHint: The bot image to run. Only images the instance allows can be applied.

agent-card-container-fields.imageNotAllowed: The saved image is not on the allowlist and will be refused.

agent-card-egress-fields.title: Egress
agent-card-egress-fields.description: Which project this bot belongs to in the egress journal, and the destinations only this bot may reach. The project's own list and its journal-or-blocking mode are edited on the project page.
agent-card-egress-fields.projectHint: The project whose egress list applies to this bot. Empty means no project list applies.
agent-card-egress-fields.allowHint: One per line: host or host:port. Added to the project's list.

agent-card-lsp-fields.title: Language servers
agent-card-lsp-fields.modeHint: Diagnostics after code edits. Limited: one TypeScript server per worktree with a memory cap and a short idle timeout. Off: none. Full: the runtime defaults.
agent-card-lsp-fields.inForce: In force: {{mode}}. {{hint}} Changes apply on the bot's next reconcile, while it is paused.

agent-card-models-fields.visionHint: Model for image analysis. Empty keeps the profile setting.
agent-card-models-fields.videoHint: Model for video input. Empty keeps the profile setting.
agent-card-models-fields.sttHint: Model for transcribing audio. Empty keeps the profile setting.
agent-card-models-fields.ttsHint: Model for voice replies. Empty keeps the profile setting.
agent-card-models-fields.titleGenerationHint: Model for auxiliary title generation. Empty keeps the instance default.
agent-card-models-fields.compressionSummaryHint: Model for auxiliary compression summaries. Empty keeps the instance default.
agent-card-models-fields.effortHint: Reasoning depth. Only values the selected model accepts are offered; empty uses the model's default.
agent-card-models-fields.effortEmpty: Empty compiles to the model default: {{value}}
agent-card-models-fields.tokensWhole: {{label}} must be a whole number of tokens.
agent-card-models-fields.contextLengthHint: Explicit context window for the model. Empty keeps the profile setting.
agent-card-models-fields.compressionHint: Absolute token cap for context compression. Empty uses the company default ({{value}}).
agent-card-models-fields.title: Additional models
agent-card-models-fields.fallbackHint: Tried in order when the main model fails.

agent-card-parallel-helpers-fields.title: Parallel helpers
agent-card-parallel-helpers-fields.toggleHint: When on, the agent can split work across helper subagents (delegate_task). When off, the delegation tool is removed from its toolset.
agent-card-parallel-helpers-fields.maxHintCeiling: How many helpers may run at once. The company ceiling is {{ceiling}}; values above it are clamped server-side. There is no built-in upper limit on the ceiling itself (the operator sets it in settings).
agent-card-parallel-helpers-fields.maxHintNoCeiling: How many helpers may run at once. The company ceiling is not set (default 10); values above it are clamped server-side. There is no built-in upper limit on the ceiling itself (the operator sets it in settings).
agent-card-parallel-helpers-fields.modelHint: Model the helper subagents run on. Empty inherits the agent's own model.
agent-card-parallel-helpers-fields.budgetHint: Turn cap per helper subagent. Empty keeps the server default.
agent-card-parallel-helpers-fields.applyNote: Changes apply on the bot's next reconcile tick, without a restart.

agent-card-team-liveness-fields.autoResumeHint: Which layer decides that the board resumes this agent after a failed run, with backoff. The instance settings say {{value}} right now.
agent-card-team-liveness-fields.runStallHint: Which layer decides that a run of this agent that stops recording progress is interrupted and its task returns to the queue. The instance settings say {{value}} right now.
agent-card-team-liveness-fields.idlePickupHint: Which layer decides that the board wakes this agent while it is idle with a ready task. The instance settings say {{value}} right now.
agent-card-team-liveness-fields.title: Team liveness
agent-card-team-liveness-fields.note: Changes apply on the agent's next pass, without a restart. The wake budget and the wake throttle are company-wide and stay on the instance settings page.

agent-memory-settings-panel.urlError: Enter an http(s):// address, or leave it empty
agent-memory-settings-panel.title: Agent memory
agent-memory-settings-panel.description: The shared memory service behind the Memory tab on an agent card. Saving applies on the next request, without a restart. Leave a field empty to use the server environment.
agent-memory-settings-panel.enabledLabel: Show agent memory on agent cards
agent-memory-settings-panel.urlHint: Empty = the server environment, then the bot containers' memory address.
agent-memory-settings-panel.keyHint: Name of the company secret with the key. Empty = no key is sent (a service without authentication).
agent-memory-settings-panel.inForceWithKey: In force: on, address from {{source}}, with a key.
agent-memory-settings-panel.inForceNoKey: In force: on, address from {{source}}, no key.
agent-memory-settings-panel.inForceOff: In force: off (no address is configured, or the switch is off).
agent-memory-settings-panel.saveFailed: Saving the agent memory settings failed.
agent-memory-settings-panel.loadFailed: Failed to load agent memory settings.

agent-tool-access-section.title: Tool and connection access
agent-tool-access-section.description: All: the agent reaches every tool it could before (default). Listed: only the tools and connections named below; any other call is refused and recorded in the activity log.

agent-memory-tab.statusDisabled: Agent memory is not enabled on this instance.
agent-memory-tab.statusNoBank: This agent has no memory bank configured (its memory is closed).
agent-memory-tab.title: Memory
agent-memory-tab.emptyDescription: Entries appear here as the agent retains facts during runs.
agent-memory-tab.clearDescription: Removes every memory entry of this agent. Type the agent id to confirm.
agent-memory-tab.clearInputAria: Type the agent id to confirm clearing the bank
agent-memory-tab.removedNotice: Memory removed. The service keeps it invalidated (recoverable) and the removal is in the activity log.
agent-memory-tab.clearedNotice: Bank cleared ({{number}} entries removed). The clear is in the activity log.
agent-memory-tab.exportedTruncated: Exported {{shown}} of {{total}} entries (large bank, export capped). The export is in the activity log.
agent-memory-tab.exported: Exported {{shown}} entries. The export is in the activity log.
